theme.title: Across the NBA

theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many points did Kobe Bryant score against Toronto on January 22, 2006?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On January 22, 2006, Bryant scored a career-high 81 points

funFacts.text: The Lakers trailed Toronto by 14 points at halftime before Kobe took over.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Lakers trailed 63–49 at halftime

funFacts.text: Bryant poured in 55 points after halftime alone.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: with 55 points in the second half

funFacts.text: He played 42 minutes and knocked down seven threes during the explosion.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bryant play 42 minutes, shooting 28-of-46 from the field, including 7-of-13 on three-pointers

questions.prompt: How many straight games did Seattle win to start its 1993–94 season?
questions.note: Ten straight wins to start the campaign.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winning their first ten games of the regular season

funFacts.text: Seattle reached a 26–3 record early in that spectacular regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The team got off to a 26–3 start to the season

funFacts.text: By the All-Star break, the Sonics were 35–10 and led the entire NBA.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: held a league-best 35–10 record at the All-Star break

funFacts.text: Seattle finished the season by winning 17 of its last 19 games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: won 17 of their final 19 games of the season

questions.prompt: How many assists per game did Mike Bibby average for the 2002 Kings?
questions.context: Sacramento · first season after the Grizzlies trade
questions.note: 5.0 assists per game as Sacramento's new point guard.

funFacts.text: Bibby started all eighty regular-season games he played.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Mike Bibby | 80 | 80 | 33.2

funFacts.text: He averaged 20.3 points in the ensuing playoffs.
His postseason three-point accuracy was 42.4 percent.

questions.prompt: Golden State made what was then the second-most threes in a Finals game, in Game 5 of 2019. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Golden State made 20 three-pointers, the second most in NBA Finals history behind Cleveland's 24

funFacts.text: Durant returned in the road elimination game but suffered a serious Achilles injury shortly afterward.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he was lost for the game two minutes into the second quarter

funFacts.text: Curry and Thompson combined for consecutive late threes to keep Golden State alive for another game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They combined for three straight 3-pointers after the Raptors led by six points

funFacts.text: Kyle Lowry nearly won the series with a buzzer-beating three, but Draymond Green deflected the shot.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Lowry's potential championship-winning, 3-point shot at the buzzer fell short
